# Sandra Leifer (Сандра Лейфер, סנדרה לייפר)

> Sandra Leifer is an artist and visual-arts teacher who lives and works in Israel. She is a NeuroGraphica (Нейрографика, נוירוגרפיקה) instructor and supervisor with more than 20 years of experience teaching visual arts, and a member of the Union of Professional Artists of Israel and of the UNESCO Artists' Union. The site shows her paintings, NeuroGraphica works and body art, a free interactive NeuroGraphica guide, and her illustrated fairy tales. Pages are in Hebrew, Russian and English; the NeuroGraphica landing page is in Russian (main), Hebrew and English.

Contact: WhatsApp +972 53-538-0014 (https://wa.me/972535380014). Individual lessons, group workshops and creative labs for children and adults; format, place, language and time are agreed with Sandra directly. The site gives no prices or dates for lessons.

## NeuroGraphica (Нейрографика)

- [Нейрографика с Сандрой Лейфер (Russian)](https://sandraleifer.com/ru/neurographica/): what NeuroGraphica is, the limit-removal algorithm, the basic steps, FAQ, Sandra's NeuroGraphica works, how to book a session.
- [נוירוגרפיקה עם סנדרה לייפר (Hebrew)](https://sandraleifer.com/neurographica/): the same page in Hebrew.
- [NeuroGraphica with Sandra Leifer (English)](https://sandraleifer.com/en/neurographica/): the same page in English.
- [Free interactive NeuroGraphica guide](https://sandraleifer.com/neurographics/): try the method step by step in the browser, on paper or on the phone, in Hebrew, Russian or English. Nothing is sent anywhere.
